name: Page transitions
summary: Slide pages in and out of the window the tt10 way, with one header per page outside the window and a window title that changes only after the old page has gone.
qualityBar: Slide in is 0.4 s outCubic from 160 px, slide out 0.35 s inCubic to -160 px, alpha 0 at both ends (exact endpoints, mid-points checked against the curves)
Overlap is 0.1 s: both pages are visible in it, the next is absent before it
Header comes in 0.05 s after its page, leaves 0.3 s before it, 56 px, baselines 446/514; one header is gone before the next starts
Window title changes only after the previous page ends
validatePlan flags a wrong overlap, a title that changes early, a page that outlives the window, a too-short page
Demo 8 s 1080x1920 silent: engine QC passes, no frozen run, closer correct
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (43 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed with 5 warning(s), motion floor 0.009710679216149412).
